entities.name: Reality Chip
entities.description: An illegal bio-enhancement artifact from Kamigawa that influences the physics of reality, built with kami essences.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: A planeswalker who developed the Reality Chip and can manipulate it from a short distance.

entities.name: Saiba Futurists
entities.description: Group who helped Tezzeret develop the Reality Chip.

entities.name: Kyodai
entities.description: A kami Tezzeret unsuccessfully tried to control with a prototype chip.

entities.name: The Wanderer
entities.description: Kamigawan planeswalker and Emperor whose spark was ignited unstably by the prototype chip.

entities.name: Kaito Shizuki
entities.description: A Kamigawan planeswalker who found the chip's blueprint and argued it could stabilize the Wanderer's spark.

entities.name: Tameshi
entities.description: Kaito's friend, in whose office and laboratory the blueprint and chip were found.

entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: A Kamigawan planeswalker who helped Kaito and was later compleated by Jin-Gitaxias as the first Phyrexian planeswalker.

entities.name: Jin-Gitaxias
entities.description: A Phyrexian who owned a compleated version of the chip and compleated Tamiyo.

entities.name: Eiganjo Castle
entities.description: Castle the Emperor wanted to return to quickly.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: Plane Tezzeret traveled to with Tamiyo.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: Plane where the Reality Chip originates.

events.summary: Tezzeret and the Saiba Futurists develop the Reality Chip; a prototype fails to control Kyodai but ignites the Emperor's unstable spark.
events.quote: The Chip ignited the Emperor 's planeswalker's spark but left it unstable

events.summary: Kaito finds the chip in Tameshi's laboratory and is attacked by Jin-Gitaxias and the Reckoners; Tamiyo and the Wanderer save him.
events.quote: He was saved by Tamiyo and the returned Wanderer.

events.summary: The Wanderer attaches the chip to her hand and it stabilizes her spark for a time.
events.quote: The Wanderer attached the Reality Chip to her hand and it helped to stabilize her spark for a while.

events.summary: Tamiyo and Kaito walk into a trap set by Tezzeret and Jin-Gitaxias; the Emperor intervenes and they capture Tezzeret.
events.quote: However, the Emperor saw this trap being sprung, and so intervened, saving Kaito and Tamiyo.

events.summary: Tezzeret wakes, crashes the mech and kidnaps Tamiyo to New Phyrexia.
events.quote: He then kidnapped Tamiyo and traveled back to New Phyrexia using the Planar Bridge .

events.summary: Jin-Gitaxias, possibly aided by the chip, compleats Tamiyo as the first Phyrexian planeswalker.
events.quote: the Reality Chip possibly allowed Jin-Gitaxias to compleat Tamiyo as the first Phyrexian planeswalker

relations.note: developed it with the Saiba Futurists
relations.quote: The Reality Chip was developed by Tezzeret with help from the Saiba Futurists .
Another native Kamigawan planeswalker, Tamiyo , agreed to help him.
Tamiyo and Kaito walked into a trap set up by Tezzeret and Jin-Gitaxias.
